description:
This process starts with a department outlining its objectives for the upcoming period, such as hiring, equipment needs, or marketing efforts.
The team drafts a plan that includes cost estimates and justifications for the budget requested.
The plan is first reviewed in a strategic alignment meeting to ensure it aligns with broader organizational goals.
Following this, the finance department performs a detailed review to assess the budget's feasibility.
The plan may undergo several rounds of review and possible adjustments based on feedback from these reviews.
Each adjustment is documented and approved by necessary stakeholders.
Once the final version of the budget is approved, the budget is officially allocated to the department.
The process ends when the budget is distributed, and the department begins implementing its plan.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/budget-planning">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BudgetPlanning" name="Department Budget Planning and Allocation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BudgetPlanning" name="Begin budget planning">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Outline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OutlineObjectives" name="Outline department objectives for the upcoming period">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Outline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outline_Draft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan" name="Draft plan with cost estimates and budget justifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outline_Draft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Draft_StrategicReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_StrategicReview" name="Review plan in strategic alignment meeting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Draft_StrategicReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApproveAdjustment_StrategicReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinanceReview" name="Review budget feasibility in detail">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinanceReview_AdjustmentDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdjustmentsNeeded" name="Are adjustments needed based on review feedback?" default="Flow_NoAdjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinanceReview_AdjustmentDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdjustmentsNeeded</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdjustment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdjustPlan" name="Adjust plan based on review feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdjustmentsNeeded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdjustPlan_Document</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustment" name="Document adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdjustPlan_Document</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Document_ApproveAdjustment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveAdjustment" name="Obtain necessary stakeholder approval for adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Document_ApproveAdjustment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApproveAdjustment_StrategicReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" name="Approve final budget version">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdjustment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateBudget" name="Officially allocate budget to department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Allocate_Distribute</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeBudget" name="Distribute budget">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Allocate_Distribute</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Distribute_Implement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BeginImplementation" name="Begin implementing department plan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Distribute_Implement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Implement_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ImplementationBegun" name="Department begins implementing plan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Implement_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Outline" sourceRef="StartEvent_BudgetPlanning" targetRef="Task_OutlineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outline_Draft" sourceRef="Task_OutlineObjectives" targetRef="Task_DraftPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Draft_StrategicReview" sourceRef="Task_DraftPlan" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview" sourceRef="Task_StrategicReview" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinanceReview_AdjustmentDecision" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustmentsNeeded" name="Adjustments needed" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsNeeded" targetRef="Task_AdjustPlan">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">adjustmentsNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdjustment" name="No adjustments needed" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsNeeded" targetRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustPlan_Document" sourceRef="Task_AdjustPlan" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Document_ApproveAdjustment" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment" targetRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproveAdjustment_StrategicReview" name="Adjustment approved; review again" sourceRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate" sourceRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Distribute" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="Task_DistributeBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Distribute_Implement" sourceRef="Task_DistributeBudget" targetRef="Task_BeginImplementation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Implement_End" sourceRef="Task_BeginImplementation" targetRef="EndEvent_ImplementationBegun"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
